findings.title: Imported feed HTML bypasses sanitization and is rendered as trusted HTML
findings.body: This marks imported post content as `raw_html`, causing `Post#cook` to return the raw value without the normal rendering and sanitization pipeline. Feed content is only HTML-unescaped before reaching this call, and the embed view later inserts `post.cooked` as raw HTML. A feed entry containing script-capable markup can therefore execute JavaScript in the Discourse origin whenever the embed is viewed, potentially compromising forum users. Sanitize imported content before storing it or do not bypass the normal safe rendering pipeline.

findings.title: Feed entries without `content` abort the entire polling job
findings.body: Many valid RSS/Atom entries provide their body as `description` or omit a body entirely, leaving `i.content` nil. Calling `scrub` on nil raises, so the job stops at that entry and never imports later entries in the feed. Handle missing content (and use the appropriate description field where available) so one incomplete item does not prevent the rest of the feed from being processed.
